#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;
const long long INV2 = (MOD + 1) / 2;

long long powMod(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    base %= mod;
    if (base < 0) base += mod;
    long long res = 1 % mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = res * base % mod;
        base = base * base % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    long long k = r - l;
    long long even = k / 2 + 1;
    long long odd = (k + 1) / 2;
    long long cells = n * m;
    long long ans;
    if (cells % 2 == 1) {
        ans = powMod(k + 1, cells, MOD);
    } else {
        long long a = powMod(even + odd, cells, MOD);
        long long b = powMod(even - odd, cells, MOD);
        ans = ((a + b) % MOD) * INV2 % MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
